name: iOS Tweak (Theos)
summary: A Logos tweak with a Makefile, control file, filter plist and a GitHub build that makes the .dylib.

files.Makefile:
# Builds with Theos (https://theos.dev). See README.md for building on GitHub.
TARGET := iphone:clang:latest:14.0
ARCHS = arm64 arm64e
INSTALL_TARGET_PROCESSES = SpringBoard

include $(THEOS)/makefiles/common.mk

TWEAK_NAME = __PROJECT__

__PROJECT___FILES = Tweak.x
__PROJECT___CFLAGS = -fobjc-arc
__PROJECT___FRAMEWORKS = UIKit

include $(THEOS_MAKE_PATH)/tweak.mk
files.control:
Package: com.yourname.__PROJECT__
Name: __PROJECT__
Version: 0.0.1
Architecture: iphoneos-arm
Description: A tweak made with MangoIDE.
Maintainer: Your Name
Author: Your Name
Section: Tweaks
Depends: mobilesubstrate (>= 0.9.5000)
files.__PROJECT__.plist:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
	<key>Filter</key>
	<dict>
		<key>Bundles</key>
		<array>
			<string>com.apple.springboard</string>
		</array>
	</dict>
</dict>
</plist>
files..github/workflows/build.yml:
# Builds the tweak on GitHub every time you push. Download the result from the run's Artifacts.
name: Build tweak
on: [push, workflow_dispatch]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install build tools
        run: brew install ldid make xz
      - name: Get Theos
        run: git clone --recursive --depth 1 https://github.com/theos/theos.git "$HOME/theos"
      - name: Build
        run: |
          export THEOS="$HOME/theos"
          export PATH="$(brew --prefix make)/libexec/gnubin:$PATH"
          make package FINALPACKAGE=1
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: __PROJECT__
          path: |
            packages/*.deb
            .theos/obj/**/*.dylib
files.README.md:
# __PROJECT__

An iOS tweak written in [Logos](https://theos.dev/docs/logos-syntax).

| File | What it's for |
| --- | --- |
| `Tweak.x` | Your hooks |
| `__PROJECT__.plist` | Which apps the tweak loads into (bundle IDs) |
| `control` | Package name, version and description |
| `Makefile` | Build settings for Theos |

## Building

An iPhone can't compile tweaks, so the project builds on GitHub:

1. In MangoIDE open **GitHub** and **Publish to GitHub**.
2. GitHub builds it automatically (the **Actions** tab shows progress).
3. Open the finished run and download the artifact: it holds the `.deb` and the `.dylib`.

Change `com.apple.springboard` in `__PROJECT__.plist` to the bundle ID of the app you want to hook.
